name: letta-passage
title: Letta Passage
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta Passage entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: last_updated_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The creation date of the passage.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was last updated.

fields.name: is_deleted
fields.description: Whether this passage is deleted or not.

fields.name: archive_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the archive containing this passage.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Deprecated: Use `folder_id` field instead. The data source of the passage.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the file associated with the passage.

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: The name of the file (only for source passages).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The human-friendly ID of the Passage

fields.name: embedding_config
fields.description: The embedding configuration used by the passage.
